`--attrs_merge`

### AnnData options

Options for how to concatenate the AnnData objects when concatenating the
main tables of the SpatialData objects using `anndata.concat`.

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--anndata_join`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The type of join to perform on the AnnData objects when concatenating
the main tables of the SpatialData objects:

- "inner": Only variables (genes) that are present in all objects are
  kept.
- "outer": All variables (genes) that are present in any object are
  kept. Sparse arrays are padded with zeros, other objects are filled
  with missing values.

See `anndata.concat` for details.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"inner"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"inner"`, `"outer"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--anndata_merge`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The method to use for merging elements that are not aligned with `obs`
when concatenating the main tables of the SpatialData objects:

- None: No elements are kept.
- "same": Only elements that are the same across all objects are kept.
- "unique": Elements for which there is only one possible value are
  kept.
- "first": The first element at each position is kept.
- "only": Elements that are only in one object are kept.

See `anndata.concat` for details.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"same"`, `"unique"`, `"first"`, `"only"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--anndata_uns_merge`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The method to use for merging elements in `uns` when concatenating the
main tables of the SpatialData objects. See `anndata_merge` for
options and details. Merging is applied recursively.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"same"`, `"unique"`, `"first"`, `"only"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--anndata_label`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The name of the column in `obs` of the concatenated main table to
store batch label information. If not provided, no batch label column
is added.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"sample"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--anndata_pairwise`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether pairwise elements (`obsp`/`varp`) are concatenated.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `false`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/dataflow/concatenate_spatialdata/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_spatial/v0.7.0/components/dataflow/concatenate_spatialdata);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/dataflow/concatenate_spatialdata/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
